data: Considering the color and position of the lines in the graph, which of the following statements are true?

The caption states that the architecture is specified as n × m, where m is the number of hidden layers and n the number of neurons per layer. The figure shows validation error curves for models that are too wide. The lines represent different architectures, with their corresponding labels shown on the right side of the graph. The x-axis represents the number of epochs, and the y-axis represents the validation error. The lines are colored differently to distinguish between the architectures. The statement "The lines are colored differently to represent different architectures" is true. The statement "The lines are positioned differently to represent different architectures" is also true, as the lines are placed vertically on the graph, with each line representing a different architecture. Therefore, both statements are true.
